dia_chi_raw: Tầng 15, tòa Keangnam Landmark 72, Mễ Trì
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Design scalable, secure, and maintainable application architecture for on-premises and/or public cloud environments.
Define standard deployment patterns (VM-based, container-based, Kubernetes-based) and guide teams on best-fit approaches.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and reusable templates to improve delivery speed, quality, and traceability.
Install, configure, and harden middleware components (Nginx/Apache HTTPD/Tomcat), including TLS and routing best practices.
Establish and promote architecture standards, security guidelines, and design principles (secrets handling, least privilege, secure defaults).
Produce and maintain architecture documentation (diagrams, ADRs, runbooks, deployment guides).
Collaborate with development, QA, product, and operations teams to ensure smooth releases and stable operations.
Contribute to an AI Agent solution development project.
yeu_cau:
Proven ability to design application architecture and deliver modern applications in On-premises and/or Public Cloud environments.
Working knowledge of CI/CD using tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo CD/GitOps, or equivalent.
Ability to install and configure at least one middleware stack (Nginx, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat).
Capability to deploy applications on at least one of: on-premises servers, public cloud, containers, Kubernetes.
Familiarity with artifact/container registries (e.g., Nexus Repository, Harbor, Docker Registry) including publishing, versioning, and access control.
Understanding Linux fundamentals and basic networking (DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS).
Strong communication skills and effective collaboration with developers.
Intermediate English communication skills (speaking).
quyen_loi:
Salary and bonus based on ability
Young and fun working environment
Opportunities to study and work abroad.

- Best remuneration: Periodically review and adjust salary once a year, PI bonus twice a. Allowances for lunch, transportation, and phone charges. Party with the team once a. Workshop travel for the whole company once a year. Bonuses/Gifts for holidays, International Labor Day, International Women's Day, etc.
- High-class, modern office: 5-star standard office with modern equipment, large rest and entertainment areas (game area, karaoke room, reading room, cafe counter, snack bar, etc.) Meet all members' needs, especially the office has an airy and beautiful view that is among the most beautiful in Hanoi.
- Top equipment: Each employee is equipped with the latest generation LG Gram laptop and modern large LG screen.
- Best working time: Work 8 hours/day (8:00 ~ 17:00), from Monday to Friday. No pressure to work overtime/weekends!
- Flexible, youthful working style: LG CNS Vietnam members are mostly from the 9-10x generation, with a youthful, modern, and fair working style!
- Creative environment, valuing individual opinions: With a young and talented team, we always appreciate the creativity and suggestions that members make.
- Opportunities to work/study in Korea and abroad: With customers and projects mostly from abroad, your opportunities for training and onsite abroad will always be open!
- Other: Happy hours every Friday, Team outing monthly, join clubs like football, badminton, etc...
